rationale: C2 is a budget statement that the Swachh Bharat Mission will be implemented for rural latrines; a budget announcement is not an administrative order. C1 is an audit of pre-tenure activity; C4 and C5 are unrelated GOs. No GO for rural toilet construction is shown.

cited.quote: Tied Grant is to be used for the basic services of a) Sanitation and maintenance of open defecation free (ODF) status
the Swacch Bharat Mission will be implemented at a total cost of Rs.400 crore

rationale: C3 (GO dated 2021-05-20) releases Rs.901.75 crore Finance Commission tied grant to rural local bodies, earmarked partly for sanitation and ODF maintenance. It is a broad grant shared with drinking water, not a dedicated sanction for building toilets; C4 is only a budget plan; C1 is an untied grant. Partial at most.

cited.quote: The following promotions, transfers and postings are ordered with immediate effect

rationale: C1 is a GO (2021-08-09) permitting CMRL to prepare a feasibility study for MRTS in the four cities, following the C3 announcement. An official preparatory step, but no MRTS is operational.
